title: Profitable email signal engine final conformance correction
purpose: Re-run the frozen HY-EXP-0037 signal-engine specification after correcting the completed-index and 15-minute cadence implementation defects. This is an implementation conformance correction, not outcome-driven economic tuning.
conformanceRule: HY-EXP-0039 may correct only implementation deviations from the original HY-EXP-0037 frozen specification. It must not tune or change universe, features, Ridge model family, lambda grid, threshold grid, stop, target, holding horizon, costs, frequency target, max-per-day rule, entry/exit rules, or promotion gates based on HY-EXP-0037 or HY-EXP-0038 outcomes.

historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0028: Historical negative/reference evidence only; never an independent validation set.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0030: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no strategy or outcome tuning.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0032: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no family, parameter, symbol, or outcome selection.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0033: Historical negative/reference evidence only; no recovered-data tournament result is reused for selection.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0034: Only its hash-locked public source manifest and raw files are reused as a provenance reference; its outcome is not reused.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0037: Invalid implementation result; no outcome is used to tune this correction.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0038: Invalid implementation result; no outcome is used to tune this correction.

primarySources: Binance official public USD-M historical archive: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um
Existing HY-EXP-0034 hash-locked native public source files for the same window
dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Any missing, duplicate, non-contiguous, non-finite, out-of-window, hash-mismatched, non-causal, or unproven row rejects the affected source and prevents a PASS. No silent repair.

universe.eligibility: Only the fixed eight symbols with complete causal required streams in the hash-locked source manifest. No later symbol list may add, remove, or rescue a symbol.

candidateGenerator.name: BROAD_BIDIRECTIONAL_15M_CAUSAL_CANDIDATES
candidateGenerator.emission: For each complete fixed symbol and each eligible completed 15m decision, emit exactly one independent BUY and one independent SELL raw candidate.
candidateGenerator.regime: BULL, BEAR, or SIDEWAYS is causal context/feature only and never suppresses a raw candidate.
candidateGenerator.sidewaysAction: Retain SIDEWAYS context and emit both sides; regime may affect prediction features only.
candidateGenerator.requiredInvariant: For every complete symbol plus decisionTime, raw BUY count equals one and raw SELL count equals one in every BULL, BEAR, and SIDEWAYS context.

referenceTrade.entry: First exact contract-price 5m OPEN at or after decisionTime; no later rescue entry and no historical fill substitution.
referenceTrade.atr: ATR20 from completed 1h contract-price bars available no later than decisionTime
referenceTrade.terminalRule: When bar.openTime equals entryTime plus 12 hours, execute MAX_HOLD at that bar open before reading that bar high or low; then terminate.
referenceTrade.overlap: Same-symbol cooldown equals the active reference trade interval; no pyramiding or reversal. Early stop/target exit releases the symbol for a later decision.
referenceTrade.funding: Use the latest realized funding event with eventTime less than or equal to decisionTime for the feature. Apply every realized funding event strictly inside entryTime < fundingTime < exitTime using actual side and mark price.

costs.charge: One frozen all-in execution cost budget per entry and exit fill; source-embedded costs are not charged twice.

features.availability: Every feature is frozen at decisionTime or earlier; missing, late, non-finite, or non-PIT input invalidates the candidate.
features.fundingRule: Use the last realized funding event whose eventTime is less than or equal to decisionTime; an event at decisionTime is eligible and a future event is forbidden.

model.name: RIDGE_EXPECTED_RETURN_MODEL
model.targetWinsorization: Within every training fold only, clip raw training net27Bps at the training-only P01 and P99. Validation, OOF, and historical metrics always use raw unwinsorized outcomes.
model.trainingOnlyScaling: Fit feature mean/std on the training fold only; no additional feature clipping or validation-data scaling.
model.oofProtocol: For every lambda independently, run every Development walk-forward fold over the same candidate validation universe and retain a complete independent OOF prediction set. The three lambda OOF counts must be identical.
model.selection: Select jointly over lambda and deterministic predicted-edge threshold configurations from the corresponding independent OOF set only; Historical Validation cannot select lambda or threshold.
model.negativeThresholdDiagnostic: If selectedMinimumEdgeBps is less than or equal to zero, report NEGATIVE_MODEL_EDGE_THRESHOLD=true as a diagnostic only; it is not a new promotion gate.

walkForward.method: Expanding purged walk-forward with OOF-only selection
walkForward.expectedFullFoldFormula: 30 calendar days * 96 completed 15m decisions/day * 8 symbols * 2 sides
walkForward.partialFoldCounting: Count actual eligible completed 15m decisions in a partial final fold; never substitute a full-fold constant.
walkForward.lambdaCoverage: OOF candidate IDs for lambda 0.1, 1, and 10 must be identical and complete over the same validation candidate universe.
walkForward.historicalValidationRetrain: Rolling monthly causal retrain using only the trailing prior 365 days; no validation outcome selects or changes a model setting.

frequency.sameDecisionSymbolSide: Predict BUY and SELL separately. If both meet the threshold, retain only the higher predicted edge with an exact deterministic tie-break.
frequency.crossSymbolRanking: Rank eligible candidates by predicted edge at the decision boundary.

developmentSelection.search: lambda x deterministic predicted-edge threshold grid only
developmentSelection.thresholdGrid: OOF predicted-edge empirical percentiles 90.0 through 99.9 inclusive on a fixed deterministic grid, computed within Development separately for each lambda-specific OOF set.

concentration.bestEvent: The event with maximum net27Bps; best5 is the stable descending net27Bps ordering with deterministic ID tie-break.

emailPreparation.gating: EMAIL_PREPARED=true and EMAIL_ACTIVATED=false only after all historical hard gates pass
